leads.question: At tempo c0c9372 (v1.19.2, evm2 7c9f3b6d), list again every non-test caller of transact, call_tx, system_call, execute_system_call and committed_copy, as theme-tempo-nested-exec did at a9d6748 in cycle 19, and read the new nested dispatch in crates/evm2/src/evm/mod.rs (suspended_frames, enclosing_refund, current_frame taken and restored by ExecutionGuard): can any path start a transaction while a user transaction with an open PoolManager unlock is on the stack, and if so does the inner transaction get its own transient map and journal? Then rerun battery.py, targeted.py, pmdiff.py, pmdiff2.py, the call semantics set and the TIP-20 rollback probe on rpc.mainnet.tempo.xyz pinned to v1.19.2 by web3_clientVersion around each batch.
leads.why: The lock, every delta and the synced currency are transient (src/libraries/Lock.sol:13-25, src/libraries/CurrencyDelta.sol:21-39, src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol:17-36). A nested transaction that shared the outer transient map, or a restored current_frame that pointed at the wrong frame, would let one account act inside another's unlock. The cycle 19 clearance says it holds for that commit only, the release changed exactly this code, and Tempo has no second client to disagree.

leads.question: Run the shipped gcc 15.2.0 JUMPI and JUMP terminator emitters, with deferred comparison discharge into the branch condition, on the logged real states of the FullMath.mulDiv blocks 0x5757, 0x57ca, 0x5860, 0x588a, 0x58d6 and 0x58db and the other un-entered value blocks (cycles/031/theme-monad-gcc-real-states.work/out/states.jsonl). Is each branch taken exactly when pyevm.py takes it, at the operands where denominator equals prod1, prod1 is 0 and the remainder is 0?
leads.why: Any account can enter these blocks with chosen amounts and every Monad validator runs the same gcc build. A wrong branch at src/libraries/FullMath.sol:30 would skip the overflow revert and return a truncated amount; a wrong branch at :112 would drop a rounding unit owed by the caller. Cycle 32 compared words only.

leads.question: Using the MegaETH stateless validator built in cycle 16 with an inspector added, count over all validated blocks (any contract, not only the PoolManager) how often the closed producer's results include MULMOD with modulus 2^256-1 and a product of 2^256 or more, SAR, SDIV and SMOD with a negative operand, SIGNEXTEND from byte 2 of a negative value, BYTE with an index of 32 or more, and SHL or SHR by 256 or more. For each class, is there at least one validated block, and which classes has the producer never executed?
leads.why: The producer is a closed JIT executor that no RPC method reaches (F-118), and pcs 22378, 22639 and 16642 of the PoolManager were never run by it (cycle 19 theme-megaeth-producer), while the only public MegaETH compiler breaks SAR, SIGNEXTEND, BYTE and MULMOD. Uniswap v3 style pools and other contracts on MegaETH execute the same operand classes. A class the producer never executed is a place where an ordinary account could feed it a first input and keep the result before any validator objects.

leads.question: In tempo c0c9372, sload_journal and sstore_journal of crates/precompiles/src/storage/evm.rs call account_with_skip(address, skip_cold_load && is_t15()). When the skip applies and the account is cold, what does account_with_skip return (evm2 crates/evm2/src/evm/state/mod.rs:666-674), how does the TIP-20 precompile turn that into a call result, and can a transfer or balanceOf made by the PoolManager (src/types/Currency.sol:60-75, :94) ever see success with a value that was not loaded?
leads.why: This is a new T15 rule on the storage path of the precompile tokens that pools on Tempo hold. If a skipped load surfaced as a zero balance or a successful transfer instead of a failed frame, sync and settle (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288, 349-364) would book a wrong payment. T15 has no activation time yet.

leads.question: Do the HyperEVM replicas (nanoreth b92ad36 and f0cad31) re-execute each block and check the producer's state root, and if so, which of the operand classes listed for MegaETH (full-modulus MULMOD with a large product, negative SAR, SDIV, SMOD, SIGNEXTEND, out-of-range BYTE and shifts) has any contract on HyperEVM executed in a block the replicas accepted?
leads.why: HyperEVM's validator is closed and its official endpoint has no multi-transaction method, so mined blocks are the only evidence of what the producer computes. If the replicas only copy state, they are no check at all.

leads.question: The clearance of the Arc face rounding loop (cycles 1, 2 and 7, stablecoin-l1) rests on a minimum base fee of 20 gwei and on SELFDESTRUCT as the cheapest forced send. Over the last 10,000 Arc blocks, what is the lowest base fee and the lowest effective gas price paid (eth_feeHistory, eth_getBlockByNumber), does any transaction class pay zero or sponsored gas, and is there a forced native send cheaper than CREATE with value plus SELFDESTRUCT?
